title: Require a separate tester before close and merge
action: ROUND 3. The worktree holds an uncommitted partial edit to proof.rs and handlers_close.rs from a timed-out round 2 that added "design" to a role list; restore both files to HEAD first (git show HEAD:<path> > <path>), that approach is wrong. Then key the rule on files, never on role names: needs_tester(cell) = tester_rule == true AND role != "test" AND files is a non-empty array. The inline-cap refusal applies to any cell with non-empty files whose paths are not all docs-only (.md or under docs/), whatever its role. The cells add warning uses the same predicate. Add tests for a writer cell and a design cell with files. At cells add, stamp each new cell with tester_rule true and print a warning when a code-touching cell has no dependent role test cell, or a docs-only cell has no dependent checker, in the feature. In feature_proof_check, refuse a feature whose stamped cell lacks a capped dependent tester or checker, naming the cell; unstamped cells are exempt. Refuse an inline cap (--inline-reason) on a code-touching cell. Rewrite the existing tiny inline cap tests your change flips.
